note: Source-promotion manifest of the single-node scaling candidate. It records what was carried from the internal scaling branch onto the public baseline, how each file was decided, how far each was reviewed and verified, and what is still open. A provenance rule (add, take, superset, contains, closed) is a porting heuristic: it says a file resolves and loses no public line; it is NOT a semantic review or a feature allocation. Only the `review` field says what a person read. Nothing here claims the candidate is complete, builds a release or passes its full suite.
publicBaselineRetention: The candidate started from 0f8ff86 and merged public main b8e28c66 at 895f2871, so the 37 public commits after the common base are present in its history. Row reviews recorded before that merge compared against the 0f8ff86-era public files unless their decision says otherwise. For every CHANGED public file the `review` field states what was compared; where it says partially-reviewed or not-reviewed, retention of public behaviour is NOT established for that file beyond the provenance rule.
allowedFeatureDelta: expected-scale profiles, gates, transitions and downgrade (src/scale)
local catalog (src/catalog) and indexed maintenance (src/indexed), as far as ported
vector storage (src/vectors), as far as ported
segmented history contracts (src/history), as far as ported
local batch compile (src/compiler/batch), as far as ported
portable project path: contracts, local store, wire, paging (src/portable), as far as ported
durability utilities those need: directory-sync scope, streamed and create-only atomic writes, confined reads/deletes, binary embeddings

rules.add: new module, release support, or regression test absent from public main; candidate import and packaging effects require separate verification
rules.take: public unchanged since the common base, so the source change loses no public fix
rules.superset: every non-comment line of the public file is in the source file
rules.contains: every public line the source lacks existed at the common base, and the source re-adds nothing public deleted
rules.hand: both deltas read; see the decision text

categories.runtimeScope: busy-drive focused runs only; see verification
